title: Making pictures in Hollywood
summary: Actors liked the band; they stayed in California for months.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: How did you all get along with the actors and stuff when you were in Hollywood. They probably liked the band a lot.
When you all were out there making a movie.

Man, we had a whole dressing room -- place, a stage, where we rehearse our part for the picture, man, them actors got a break, the whole -- where we were playing; it was heaven. All of them was -- wherever we played -- heaven, man, and they would come over and say 'Hey, Sonny, play -- Duke, play your original compositions.' We would. We would have a jam session and every time we got a break, the place was full of guest and visitors, and they stayed so long and the man had to come there and say, 'Stop playing so them actors can get back over there on the set and do their thing.'
How long were you all out there, the first picture.
Oh, we stayed in California, making pictures, about three months. Then we come back east and we'd come back east -- we'd go to California every year and if we
didn't make a picture we'd go on a theatre tour, you know. We played all the theatres in California, San Francisco, everywhere.
